props.name: size
props.description: The size of the search field.

props.name: variant
props.description: Legacy visual variant. S2 SearchFields do not expose visual variants.

props.name: styles
props.description: Spectrum-defined generated classes.

props.name: UNSAFE_className
props.description: Additional CSS class name. Use only as a last resort.

props.name: UNSAFE_style
props.description: Additional inline styles. Use only as a last resort.

props.name: class
props.description: Backward-compatible class alias. Prefer UNSAFE_className for S2 parity.

props.name: label
props.description: Label text for the input.

props.name: description
props.description: Description text shown below the input.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Error message shown when invalid.

props.name: labelPosition
props.description: Position of the label relative to the input.

props.name: labelAlign
props.description: Text alignment for side labels.

props.name: necessityIndicator
props.description: Whether required fields show an icon or text label.

props.name: contextualHelp
props.description: A contextual help element to place next to the label.

props.name: prefix
props.description: An icon or text rendered before the input in place of the built-in search magnifier, e.g. the register's `/` slash-command glyph.

props.name: suffix
props.description: An icon or text rendered after the input, e.g. a key hint.

props.name: slot
props.description: Slot name when used in a Spectrum context.

props.name: ref
props.type: HTMLDivElement | ((el: HTMLDivElement) => void) | { current?: HTMLDivElement | null | undefined; }
props.description: Ref for the search field root element.

props.name: autoCapitalize
props.description: Controls whether and how text input is automatically capitalized.

props.name: inputMode
props.description: The input mode hint for virtual keyboards.

props.name: id
props.description: The element's unique identifier.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Handler that is called when the element loses focus.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Handler called when the value changes.

props.name: onFocus
props.description: Handler that is called when the element receives focus.

props.name: onKeyDown
props.description: Handler that is called when a key is pressed.

props.name: onKeyUp
props.description: Handler that is called when a key is released.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Handler called when the user submits the search.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that describes the object.

props.name: aria-details
props.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that provide a detailed, extended description for the object.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that labels the current element.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Whether the input is disabled.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Whether the element should receive focus on mount.

props.name: type
props.description: The type of input to render.

props.name: form
props.description: Associates the input with a form element by id.

props.name: name
props.description: The name of the input element, used when submitting an HTML form.

props.name: value
props.description: The current value (controlled).

props.name: excludeFromTabOrder
props.description: Whether to exclude the element from the sequential tab order.

props.name: onFocusChange
props.description: Handler that is called when the element's focus status changes.

props.name: validationState
props.description: Legacy validation state. Kept as a `createSlotId` dependency so a description/error slot is re-probed when this flips, matching RAC `useField` (`useField.ts:38-48`).

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The default value (uncontrolled).

props.name: isReadOnly
props.description: Whether the input is read only.

props.name: isRequired
props.description: Whether the input is required.

props.name: isInvalid
props.description: Whether the input value is invalid.

props.name: validationBehavior
props.description: Whether to use native HTML form validation or ARIA validation semantics.

props.name: validate
props.type: (value: any) => string | string[] | true | null | undefined
props.description: A function that returns an error message if a given value is invalid.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text for the input.

props.name: autoComplete
props.description: Whether to enable auto complete.

props.name: pattern
props.description: Regex pattern to validate the input value.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: The maximum number of characters supported by the input.

props.name: minLength
props.description: The minimum number of characters required by the input.

props.name: onClear
props.description: Handler called when the field is cleared.

props.name: enterKeyHint
props.description: Hint for the enter key action on virtual keyboards.

props.name: autoCorrect
props.description: Whether to enable auto correct.

props.name: spellCheck
props.description: Whether to enable spell check.

props.name: inputElementType
props.description: The element type to use for the input. Defaults to 'input'.

props.name: labelElementType
props.description: The HTML element used to render the label, e.g. 'label', or 'span'.
